title: From canvas to fragment
asset_strategy: Lead with the oil painting as source evidence, then shift into reconstruction detail, then finish on a styled wearable hero so the transformation reads as art-to-object-to-body. Use the raw painting asset as the dominant visual thread, and only bring in garment/product assets once the fragment logic is established.

slides.headline: SOURCE
slides.notes: Full-bleed archive crop on bone ground; sparse technical framing; let paint texture carry the opening.

slides.headline: CAPTURE
slides.notes: Show scan logic and reconstruction texture; keep it clinical, minimal, and slightly mysterious.

slides.headline: RECONSTRUCT
slides.notes: Use a grid-like archive frame; emphasize coordinates, crop boundaries, and fragment selection.

slides.headline: FRAGMENT
slides.notes: Introduce the garment as a desirable object; close on textile, placement, and silhouette.

slides.headline: BODY
slides.notes: Styled streetwear body shot with movement; premium city/studio energy; art-origin detail stays visible.

slides.headline: RETURN
slides.notes: Quiet closing frame with negative space; make the fragment feel complete, confident, and follow-worthy.

caption:
Canvas // capture // reconstruct // wear.
A fragment leaves the archive.
